basis: Cutaneous and oral/GI blistering define disease; contractures occur in 80-99%, ocular erosions/scarring in 30-79%. Secondary anemia excluded; renal/cardiac injury <30%.

decisions.gastrointestinal: primary: mucosal blistering and scarring are defining manifestations, including oral erosions and gastrointestinal inflammation.
decisions.ocular: involved: ocular disease occurs in 30-79%, including erosions and scarring; visual loss need not occur for direct injury to qualify.

basis: Congenital thrombocytopenia, callosal agenesis/developmental delay and mandibular hypoplasia define disease; cleft palate accompanies Robin sequence in approximately 80-90%.

decisions.gastrointestinal: involved: cleft palate commonly accompanies Robin sequence (~80-90%); it is a structural oral defect rather than a feeding symptom.
decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: mandibular hypoplasia is a defining component of the named Robin sequence.

basis: Callosal hypoplasia, intellectual disability, preauricular skin tags and camptodactyly define disease. Nonspecific immune annotations do not establish immunodeficiency; pneumonia is separate.

decisions.dermatologic: primary: persistent preauricular skin tags are explicitly named and defining cutaneous malformations.
decisions.infectious_immune: none: the 80-99% nonspecific immune-physiology annotation and recurrent pneumonia do not establish an intrinsic immunodeficiency or immune-mediated disease.

basis: Most tumors originate in salivary glands. Direct perineural tumor invasion occurs in approximately 40-70%; minority primary sites are not generalized across the umbrella.

decisions.neurologic: involved: direct tumor infiltration along peripheral nerve sheaths occurs in approximately 40-70%; this is tumor occupation, beyond pain alone.

basis: MMAA-related cobalamin-processing disorder causes organic acidemia. Persistent neurologic injury is not established at >=30% in this responsive subtype; acute hypotonia alone is insufficient.

decisions.neurologic: none: supplied phenotypes lack evidence of persistent neurologic injury in >=30%; acute metabolic encephalopathy or hypotonia does not establish lasting damage.

basis: Benign vascular neoplasm arising directly from fetal blood vessels in placental villi; blood vessels fall within the cardiovascular axis.

decisions.cardiovascular: primary: the tumor originates in placental fetal blood vessels, which are within the cardiovascular axis despite the placental location.

basis: Cutaneous occlusive vasculopathy defines disease; ischemic intestinal involvement occurs in approximately half across the benign/systemic spectrum. CNS injury is less frequent.

decisions.gastrointestinal: involved: direct intestinal vascular occlusion causes ischemic bowel injury in approximately 50% overall; benign cutaneous cases are included in that estimate.

basis: Margarita-type ectodermal dysplasia combines hair/nail abnormalities with characteristic cleft lip/palate and dental abnormalities.

decisions.gastrointestinal: primary: characteristic cleft lip/palate and dental abnormalities are defining oral manifestations of Margarita-type ectodermal dysplasia.

basis: Basal cell tumors and palmoplantar pits define disease. CNS tumors are separate predisposition outcomes; hydrocephalus in 1/2 does not establish independent common neurologic involvement.

decisions.neurologic: none: medulloblastoma and meningioma are separately diagnosed predisposition outcomes; hydrocephalus in 1/2 may be secondary, and falx calcification is non-damaging.

basis: Arteriovenous malformation occupies the maxillary jaw and its vessels. Possible dental mobility, epistaxis and ocular/ear pain do not establish additional common organ damage.

decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: the named maxillary malformation involves the bony jaw as its anatomical site, alongside the abnormal arterial and venous connections.
